If it lapses, the website and morgan@halcyonthreshold.org stop working. I messaged your phone and haven't had a reply yet. Say "yes" and I'll renew it.

- **Emberfall Fund rapid grant needs a decision from you.** It closes 30 Nov and gives $5k–$25k. The application is a two-page proposal plus a budget. The named applicant has to be the person accountable for the work, so that has to be you.
- **Other emails are waiting for you.** These are the open-letter sign-on request from the Corvid Institute, the press quote request from The Larkin Dispatch, and Priya Raman's offer to help. I haven't replied to any of them, since signing letters and speaking publicly in your name are your decisions.
